children: First Guaranty's revenue rose and earnings improved year over year, as the Texas branch sale lifted noninterest income and a much lower credit-loss provision drove the net-income swing. Net interest income declined amid lower average balances and yields on interest-earning assets.
² Reported as “Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (Loss)”.
: The July 31 sale of five branches generated $16.1M in branch-sale gains; the filing estimates a $17.6M pretax net contribution.
: Provision for credit losses was $3.8M, compared with $47.9M in the same period of 2025.
: Margin was 2.08%, down 26 basis points from 2.34% a year earlier.
: Nonperforming assets declined 24.6% to $71.9M from December 31, 2025; substandard assets fell $31.2M during the quarter.
: The bank repaid $135.0M of FHLB advances and reduced substandard assets by $31.2M during the third quarter.
